videos.title: Cem Karsan: When the VIX Hits 40, the Tinder Is Packed
videos.description:
What happens after the VIX touches 40 looks encouraging on the chart. The median return is positive and the distribution leans right. The problem is the left side of it. Cem Karsan points out that the times the VIX touched 40 against this much open interest and risk were March 2020 opex and 1987, and in those setups the tinder is packed. You can get a massive tail. If the tail doesn't transpire, the flows underneath are very positive.
